page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Greek paradigm tables set in lines and a running head at the top; no marginal notes. Page number 26 at top left; running head "DE ETYMOLOGIA" at top centre.

main_text.p: Excipe: κςνὸς, κςνόπερ, κςνόπατ, & ςενὸς, ςςνόπερ, ςςνόπατ; quæ ο retinent, penultimâ positivi exsi- stente brevi. [?]
main_text.head: ΟΥΣ.
main_text.p: Definentia in ος, comparantur, addito περος & τατ ad positivum masculinum. ut:
main_text.head: ΕΙΣ.
main_text.p: Definentia in εις, comparantur, addito περος & τατ ad positivum masculinum, elisô priùs ι. ut:
main_text.head: ΩΝ.
main_text.p: Definentia in ων, comparantur, addito περος & τατος ad nominativum pluralem positivi masculini. ut:
